name: AgileX PiPER gripper (integrated)
src: integrated in the piper model; stroke from the model's finger travel; treated as open/close only
notes: mass_kg is the figure the Payload check charges against the arm; the composed model uses the simulator model's own mass. force_n is the range of grip force it can hold. hold says how it carries an object. It comes inside the piper arm model, so it has no model, mass or price of its own.
